offlineProtection.explainerLead: You must keep the dashboard or kitchen screen (KDS) open and connected to the internet throughout the service.
offlineProtection.explainerBody: If the screen switches off, the device loses internet, or you switch to another website, offline protection takes over — it pauses ordering or turns auto-accept off, whichever you chose.
offlineProtection.reminder: ⚠️ Please keep the dashboard or kitchen screen (KDS) open and connected throughout the service, otherwise offline protection may take over.
offlineProtection.enableConfirm:
Offline protection switched on.

To keep orders coming in, your screen must stay on. If this device loses connection, offline protection takes over in the mode you chose.

Please make sure “Keep screen on” is switched on on this device.
offlineProtection.disableConfirm:
Switch off offline protection for this event?

If this device loses connection, online orders keep coming in — customers may place orders you can’t see. Please only switch it off if you have a stable connection.
offlineProtection.cardDescription: Decides what happens to incoming orders when your device loses internet.
offlineProtection.purpose: If your device loses connection, this stops orders coming in while you can’t see them.
offlineProtection.switchLabel: Order protection when there is no internet
offlineProtection.switchHelp: What happens when this van loses its connection.
offlineProtection.modes.pause.label: Pause online ordering
offlineProtection.modes.pause.help: Customers can’t order until you are back online.
offlineProtection.modes.no_auto_accept.l: Keep taking orders and confirm them yourself
offlineProtection.modes.no_auto_accept.h: Auto-accept is switched off, so customers can still order but no order is confirmed automatically. You confirm each order yourself when back online — and orders still waiting are rejected automatically after the time you chose, with an email telling the customer.
kitchenCapacity.desc: The most items your kitchen can make at once, across all the categories you ticked. Each category’s own batch size still applies on top.
kitchenCapacity.example: Example: if you can cook 4 mains in 5 minutes, set it to 4 items every 5 minutes. Total capacity limits orders across all selected categories, so if you want to sell no more than 10 starters and mains together every 5 minutes, set “Total capacity” to 10 items every 5 minutes and tick the “Starters” and “Mains” boxes. Your mains will still be limited to 4 items every 5 minutes.
kitchenCapacity.noLimit: Leave it at the infinity sign (∞) if you don’t want a limit.
kitchenCapacity.warning: ⚠️ For kitchen capacity to work properly, please set a prep time and batch size on your menu categories (Menu & Stock). Without them the system can’t know how long each item takes to cook.
kitchenCapacity.noVan: Please add a van in Settings › Truck settings to set the kitchen capacity.
kitchenCapacity.lead: How many items your kitchen can make, so customers can only choose collection times you can make in time.
kitchenCapacity.sameForAll: Use the same kitchen capacity for every van?

settingsCopy.allowCancellation.label: Allow customers to cancel orders
settingsCopy.allowCancellation.sentence: Customers can cancel up to <select></select> before the collection time
settingsCopy.autoAccept.label: Auto-accept orders
settingsCopy.autoAccept.help: Orders are confirmed automatically. If the requested slot is full, the order moves to the next free slot. Only confirms when the kitchen still has room. Orders with a customer note (e.g. a food allergy) still need confirming yourself.
settingsCopy.orderReady.label: Order-ready step
settingsCopy.orderReady.help: Shows a “Mark ready” button on the orders screen. Kitchen screens (KDS) are set separately on each device. Customers get an email every time an order is marked ready. Applies to all events — you can still switch it on or off for one event on that event’s dashboard.
settingsCopy.buzzers.label: Do you hand customers buzzers for collection?
settingsCopy.buzzers.help: Record which buzzer you gave each customer, so you know who to look for when the food is ready.
settingsCopy.buzzers.countLabel: How many buzzers do you have?
whereYouTrade.stepHeading: Where is your Food Truck based?
whereYouTrade.stepIntro: This sets your currency, prices, time zone and phone number format. The country can’t be changed later because it’s tied to your card payments.
whereYouTrade.countryGuessed: We guessed this from where you are. Please change it if it’s wrong.
whereYouTrade.townQuestion: Town or city you are based in
whereYouTrade.saveFailed: Couldn’t save the settings — please try again.

manageSettings.schedule.title: Your schedule
manageSettings.schedule.autoDesc: Tell us where you post your schedule and we’ll check it for you and send the events we find for your approval. It must be your own website — not a Facebook or Instagram page.
manageSettings.schedule.eitherWay: Either way, if we find your events elsewhere, we’ll still send them to you for approval. Nothing goes public until you confirm it.
